---
title: "Indirect effect of influenza vaccination coverage on the circulation of respiratory viruses"   
subtitle: "Supplementary Figure 19"
output: html_document
---

## Set up result directories and load required packages
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
# Output folders for pre- and post-COVID-19 results
file_path_pre <- "01.output_pre_pandemic_IAV"
file_path_post <- "01.output_post_pandemic_IAV"

# Load INLA
library(INLA)

#  Select other packages
packages <- c("data.table", "tidyverse", "sf", "sp", "spdep",
              "dlnm", "tsModel", "hydroGOF","RColorBrewer", 
              "geofacet", "ggpubr", "ggthemes","splines")

# Load packages
lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE)

```
## Prepare precomputed DLNM results

DLNM results were precomputed and saved for Figure 5 reproduction.
```{r eval=FALSE}
if (FALSE) {
# Data frames for storing pre- and post-COVID-19 model outputs
dat_sin_pre <- data.frame()
dat_sin_post <- data.frame()
# Respiratory viruses
virus_vars <- c("ADV", "HMPV", "PIV", "RSV","RV")
for (j in 1:length(virus_vars))
{
  print(virus_vars[j])  
  fig_out_pre <- paste0(file_path_pre,"/",j,".",virus_vars[j],"_figs")
  fig_out_post <- paste0(file_path_post,"/",j,".",virus_vars[j],"_figs")
  # Vaccination coverage levels
  lab <- c("mean", "high", "low") 
  for (i in 1:length(lab))
  {
    # Load pre-COVID-19 results
    res_flu_mat_pre <- read.csv(paste0(fig_out_pre,"/",virus_vars[j],"_IAV_matRRfit_",lab[i],".csv"))
    res_mat_pre <- res_flu_mat_pre
    dat_sin_pre <- rbind(dat_sin_pre,res_mat_pre)
    
    # Load post-COVID-19 results
    res_flu_mat_post <- read.csv(paste0(fig_out_post,"/",virus_vars[j],"_IAV_matRRfit_",lab[i],".csv"))
    res_mat_post <- res_flu_mat_post
    dat_sin_post <- rbind(dat_sin_post,res_mat_post)
  }
  gc()
}

}
```
## Load precomputed DLNM results

DLNM results were previously generated and saved during the Figure 5 analysis.
```{r}
dlnm_results <- readRDS("dlnm_results.rds")
dat_sin_pre <- dlnm_results$dat_sin_pre
dat_sin_post <- dlnm_results$dat_sin_post
```

## Plot Supplementary Figure S19
```{r fig.width=18, fig.height=10, dpi=300}
# Load plot theme 
source("plot_theme.R")

# Pre-COVID-19: ADV
df_sin_ADV_pre <- dat_sin_pre[dat_sin_pre$virus == "ADV" & dat_sin_pre$Lag == "lag1" & dat_sin_pre$var_type == "IAV" &
                                (dat_sin_pre$model_type == "mean"),]
# Pre-COVID-19: HMPV
df_sin_HMPV_pre <- dat_sin_pre[dat_sin_pre$virus == "HMPV" & dat_sin_pre$Lag == "lag1" & dat_sin_pre$var_type == "IAV" &
                                 (dat_sin_pre$model_type == "mean" ),]
# Pre-COVID-19: PIV
df_sin_PIV_pre <- dat_sin_pre[dat_sin_pre$virus == "PIV" & dat_sin_pre$Lag == "lag0" & dat_sin_pre$var_type == "IAV" &
                                (dat_sin_pre$model_type == "mean" ),]
# Pre-COVID-19: RSV
df_sin_RSV_pre <- dat_sin_pre[dat_sin_pre$virus == "RSV" & dat_sin_pre$Lag == "lag2" & dat_sin_pre$var_type == "IAV" &
                                (dat_sin_pre$model_type == "mean" ),]
# Pre-COVID-19: RV
df_sin_RV_pre <- dat_sin_pre[dat_sin_pre$virus == "RV" & dat_sin_pre$Lag == "lag5" & dat_sin_pre$var_type == "IAV" &
                               (dat_sin_pre$model_type == "mean" ),]

DF1 <- rbind(df_sin_ADV_pre,df_sin_HMPV_pre,df_sin_PIV_pre,df_sin_RSV_pre,df_sin_RV_pre)
DF1$virus <- factor(DF1$virus, levels = c("RSV","PIV","RV","ADV","HMPV"),ordered=TRUE)

p1_mean <-ggplot(DF1,aes(x=var,y=matRRfit,group=model_type))+
  geom_line(aes(x=var,y=matRRfit,color=model_type),linewidth=1,stat="identity")+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x=var,ymin = matRRlow, ymax = matRRhigh,fill=model_type),alpha=0.5)+
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=1),lty='dashed',colour ="black",linewidth=1)+
  facet_wrap(~ virus, scales = "free_x",nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,2.4),breaks = seq(0,3,1),expand = c(0, 0))+
  labs(x="RP of IAV detections (%)", y= "Relative risk" )+  
  ggtitle("Pre-COVID-19")+
  scale_color_manual(name = '',values = "#92C5DE",breaks = c("mean"),
                     labels=c("Without interaction model"))+ 
  scale_fill_manual(name = '',values = "#92C5DE",breaks = c("mean"),
                    labels=c("Without interaction model"))+ 
  mytheme+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 22, face = "bold"))+
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", color = "black"), 
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "black", size = 0.5))+
  theme(plot.margin=unit(c(1,1,1.2,2),'lines'))+
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=1),fill=guide_legend(nrow=1))

p1_mean


# Post-COVID-19: ADV
df_sin_ADV_post <- dat_sin_post[dat_sin_post$virus == "ADV" & dat_sin_post$Lag == "lag1" & dat_sin_post$var_type == "IAV" &
                                  (dat_sin_post$model_type == "mean"),]
# Post-COVID-19: HMPV
df_sin_HMPV_post <- dat_sin_post[dat_sin_post$virus == "HMPV" & dat_sin_post$Lag == "lag1" & dat_sin_post$var_type == "IAV" &
                                   (dat_sin_post$model_type == "mean"),]
# Post-COVID-19: PIV
df_sin_PIV_post <- dat_sin_post[dat_sin_post$virus == "PIV" & dat_sin_post$Lag == "lag0" & dat_sin_post$var_type == "IAV" &
                                  (dat_sin_post$model_type == "mean" ),]
# Post-COVID-19: RSV
df_sin_RSV_post <- dat_sin_post[dat_sin_post$virus == "RSV" & dat_sin_post$Lag == "lag3" & dat_sin_post$var_type == "IAV" &
                                  (dat_sin_post$model_type == "mean" ),]
# Post-COVID-19: RV
df_sin_RV_post <- dat_sin_post[dat_sin_post$virus == "RV" & dat_sin_post$Lag == "lag5" & dat_sin_post$var_type == "IAV" &
                                 (dat_sin_post$model_type == "mean"),]

DF2 <- rbind(df_sin_ADV_post,df_sin_HMPV_post,df_sin_PIV_post,df_sin_RSV_post,df_sin_RV_post)
DF2$virus <- factor(DF2$virus, levels = c("RSV","PIV","RV","ADV","HMPV"),ordered=TRUE)

p2_mean <-ggplot(DF2,aes(x=var,y=matRRfit,group=model_type))+
  geom_line(aes(x=var,y=matRRfit,color=model_type),linewidth=1,stat="identity")+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x=var,ymin = matRRlow, ymax = matRRhigh,fill=model_type),alpha=0.5)+
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=1),lty='dashed',colour ="black",linewidth=1)+
  facet_wrap(~ virus, scales = "free_x",nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,3.6),breaks = seq(0,4,1),expand = c(0, 0))+
  labs(x="RP of IAV detections (%)", y= "Relative risk" )+  
  ggtitle("Post-COVID-19")+
  scale_color_manual(name = '',values = "#92C5DE",breaks = c("mean"),
                     labels=c("Without interaction model"))+ 
  scale_fill_manual(name = '',values = "#92C5DE",breaks = c("mean"),
                    labels=c("Without interaction model"))+ 
  mytheme+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 22, face = "bold"))+
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", color = "black"), 
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "black", size = 0.5))+
  theme(plot.margin=unit(c(1,1,1.2,2),'lines'))+
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=1),fill=guide_legend(nrow=1))

p2_mean

figS19 <-ggarrange(p1_mean, p2_mean,ncol =1, nrow = 2,heights = c(1,1),
                 labels = c("A","B"),  hjust=-1, vjust=1.5,align = "hv",
                 legend = "bottom", common.legend = T,
                 font.label = list(size = 24, face = "bold"))
figS19 


ggsave(figS19,filename = file.path(paste0("FigS19.pdf")),device   = cairo_pdf,  family   = "Arial",
       width = 18,height =10)
```
